C02.title: Pipeline driver and the demo slice (plan 4.1)

items.item: the driver runs submit → discover → normalise → constraints → clarify → confirm → overlap → plan → generate → candidate → validate → decide → export → publish and records every step
tests: 4.1 the driver runs the whole slice on the transactions demo

items.item: with every declared gate satisfied the driver reports VERIFIED_WITHIN_SCOPE, and the export says what it does not claim
tests: 4.1 when every declared gate is satisfied

items.item: a generated oracle caps the result at review-only until a person confirms it
tests: 4.1 without a person's confirmation the generated oracle caps

items.item: confirmAcceptance: a person turns generated expected outcomes into a reviewed oracle by a recorded decision; contract versioned, candidate staled (S6)
tests: S6 confirming generated outcomes is a recorded decision

items.item: PLAN mode stops after the plan; a repeated run with the same key builds nothing twice
tests: 4.1 PLAN mode stops after the plan

items.item: the driver never answers for a person: an open question stops it and the caller's answer continues it
tests: 4.1 the driver never answers for a person

items.item: a failing check blocks and nothing is exported
the draft-PR step needs a bound issue and a forge; with both, one draft PR results
tests: 4.1 the draft-PR step needs a bound issue

items.item: REAL: build and tests run in a container on the candidate's exact bytes and the slice reaches VERIFIED_WITHIN_SCOPE; the user's tree is untouched
tests: 4.1 REAL: build and tests run inside a container

items.item: a container-class Runner with its own audit (non-root, read-only root, pid and memory limits, no network, same flag and env refusals)
tests: 1.F the container runner passes the audit written for it
1.F the container runner runs a real command
1.F the container runner stops a run at the wall limit

items.needs: a .cie/perf.json with a workload, a measurement plan and budgets bound to an authority, and a runner for the repetitions; the verified runs declare performance not applicable and say the change was not measured

items.item: browser gate on a UI feature in a container
items.needs: a Chromium image and the audited browser runner; the demo change touches no UI file so the gate is not applicable

items.item: an operation that exposes the driver to the web app and CLI
items.needs: a C02/runFeaturePipeline gateway operation (long job) and its UI entry; the driver is a library call today
